rule: One abstract base holds the body plan; each variant is a copy-from child listing only its diffs: name and text, colour, one stat band or one behaviour key (special attack, melee damage), and an optional looks_like pointer to borrow a sprite. Elites and tier-ups are a weighted pick from a named monstergroup pool, decided by the game (donor uses a half_life timer; we decide at spawn on the server).
